blind_solver.note: Every flag the solvers raised is recorded verbatim in substance, including the ones that count against this architecture. No stem was modified in response to any of them.

counter_evidence_not_to_be_read_past.note: The accepted-item safety counts are all zero because both accepted items are clean, not because the pilot produced few defects. Across all ten realized items the reviewers recorded 45 defects. The repository's own reviewer-calibration rule is to compare defect counts rather than pass rates, so both are reported.

protocol: Three fresh Opus-level contexts, none of which authored the items. Each was given only its own review packet: stem, lead-in, options with the key marked, author rationales, and the verbatim text of every evidence claim the rationales cite. No contrast matrix, no blueprint, no blind-solver output, no pilot narrative. The instruction set the task's own Phase 13 standard: any count above zero on the nine safety dimensions forces REJECT.

reviewer_identified_systematic_root_caus.finding: A distractor rationale excludes its option by asserting that a condition is not met here when the stem is silent on that condition, and in several cases the item's own frozen evidence packet works against the exclusion.
reviewer_identified_systematic_root_caus.traced_to: The deterministic rationale template in the option realization layer, which appends the fixed clause 'That condition is not met here.' to every competitor's correctness condition without checking whether the stem states the condition to be false or is merely silent about it.

G2-MED-03.REJECT_REASON: Furosemide and sublingual nitroglycerin are eliminated by one and the same preload proposition, so one option slot does no independent work. The paired troponin values have no role in the decision the lead-in asks for in an activated primary-PCI pathway and read as inserted item furniture; they also imply an awkward total ischaemic time.
G2-MED-03.notable: The key, the RV-infarct physiology and the safety teaching point were all judged correct. Also flagged a mild lone-category cue: the key is the only option that adds preload.

G2-OBGYN-01.REJECT_REASON: Two unsupported rationale claims. The packet says an abscess often presents with a palpable collection, which does not license the categorical inverse that no fluctuance excludes a drainable collection, and that sentence would teach a candidate to under-use ultrasound in a lactating woman with a mass. The packet also attaches the stated presentation to inflammatory mastitis and never supplies a criterion for calling it bacterial.
G2-OBGYN-01.notable: Stem, key and option set were all judged sound and the stem specifically scored zero for unnatural engineering. The defect is confined to the rationale text.

G2-PED-01.REJECT_REASON: The asymmetric reduced air entry was inserted to keep pneumonia and foreign body live and is then dismissed in the key rationale by a claim no cited packet supports; that same claim contradicts the item's own foreign-body rationale, leaves pneumonia as a defensible second key, and would teach a candidate to under-weight the cardinal sign of foreign body aspiration in an infant.

G2-PED-02.REJECT_REASON: The keyed answer is arguably wrong. The stem's own facts satisfy the guideline conditions the rationales say are unmet: the cohorting sentence is the cited indication for viral testing, and failure to improve is the cited indication for a radiograph, while the infant meets none of the quoted preconditions for intermittent monitoring. Not repairable by editing rationales.

G2-PHELO-01.REJECT_REASON: Length-time bias is a defensible second key. Randomisation excludes healthy-screenee bias but not length bias or overdiagnosis, and the stem supplies no case-mix or case-count data to separate them from lead time, so the rationales exclude two options by asserting facts the stem never states.
G2-PHELO-01.notable: The stem scored zero for unnatural engineering and read as an ordinary randomised screening trial report.

G2-PHELO-02.notable: All three distractors judged live and inferior, with the voluntariness option named as the strongest competitor. Mild lone-category cue noted: the key is the only option beginning Replace against three beginning Add.

G2-PHELO-03.notable: Declared HARD, judged EASY: the capacity shortfall is stated so unambiguously and closed off so completely that little inference is left. Two mild cues noted, both lone-category and stem-language echo.

G2-PSY-03.REJECT_REASON: Digitally delivered CBT is a second defensible key. The access barrier the blueprint inserted to defeat in-person psychotherapy is precisely the condition under which digital CBT is indicated, so it strengthens that competitor rather than weakening it, and the stem reports no patient preference, which is the only stated ground for preferring medication.
G2-PSY-03.notable: The stem itself scored zero for unnatural engineering and was called a realistic Canadian presentation.

G2-SURG-01.REJECT_REASON: Pelvic inflammatory disease and tubo-ovarian abscess test the same discrimination, the latter being a complication of the former, and both rationales defeat their option using pelvic examination findings the stem never reports. A lone-category cue is also present: the key is the only non-gynaecologic option.
G2-SURG-01.notable: The stem scored zero for unnatural engineering and was judged an entirely believable presentation.

G2-SURG-02.REJECT_REASON: The stem's own findings score Alvarado 7, the high band calling for surgical consultation, while the stem asserts intermediate suspicion and the key depends on the intermediate band; the quoted Alvarado bands overlap at 4; ultrasonography is a defensible second key on the item's own stepwise evidence and is defeated only by a body-habitus fact the stem never gives; MRI and ultrasound-with-KUB have no positive stem anchor; and the pre-declared probability band, the contrast clearance and the availability clause are all present because options need them.
G2-SURG-02.notable: This is the pilot's worst item on every construction dimension and the clearest instance of the failure mode the design predicted.
